primaryContext.candidateText: Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might not allow anyone to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.
primaryContext.fixedText: Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might not allow anyone to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.

primaryContext.candidateText: When Baasha heard of it, he stopped building Ramah, and lived in Tirzah.
primaryContext.fixedText: When Baasha heard of it, he stopped building Ramah, and lived in Tirzah.

primaryContext.candidateText: Then King Asa made a proclamation to all Judah. No one was exempted. They carried away the stones of Ramah, and its timber, with which Baasha had built; and King Asa used it to build Geba of Benjamin, and Mizpah.
primaryContext.fixedText: Then King Asa made a proclamation to all Judah. No one was exempted. They carried away the stones of Ramah, and its timber, with which Baasha had built; and King Asa used it to build Geba of Benjamin, and Mizpah.
